digest.component_or_area: lock management across enrichment drain, compaction worker, and GC worker
propositions: The O_EXCL-create-and-stamp loop is duplicated identically across three modules (enrich_drain, compact_trigger, gc_trigger) instead of being shared, violating DRY and introducing maintenance risk.

Release semantics differ unsafely: enrich_drain wraps close() and unlink() in a single try block, so OSError from close() skips unlink and leaks the lock file until the 3600 s ceiling; compact_trigger and gc_trigger use independent try blocks ensuring unlink always runs.
The stamp bytes differ trivially (drain appends newline, others do not) but both readers strip(), creating invisible technical debt and brittleness.
Logging and error handling differ: drain names the lock holder and warns on stamp failure; the other two log bare messages and swallow stamp failures, violating observability uniformity.

The shared helper stamped_file_lock() must accept a describe_holder callback to preserve drain's contractually pinned holder naming (pinned by test_drain_and_doctor_describe_a_holderless_lock_identically) while remaining generic for compaction and GC workers.
